mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( course_id, user_id, content, likes_count, save_count, created_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.course_id AS courseId, p.user_id AS userId, c.name AS title, p.content, p.likes_count AS likesCount, p.save_count AS saveCount, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM post p LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.post_id, p.course_id, c.name AS title, p.likes_count AS like_count, p.save_count AS bookmark_count FROM post p JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.course_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.creation_type <> 'SYSTEM' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.course_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.creation_type <> 'SYSTEM'

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS title, p.content FROM post p JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.course_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.creation_type <> 'SYSTEM'
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET likes_count = likes_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE post SET likes_count = CASE WHEN likes_count > 0 THEN likes_count - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE post SET save_count = save_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE post SET save_count = CASE WHEN save_count > 0 THEN save_count - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND deleted_at IS NULL
